import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class SimpleEdge {
        int trg;
        SimpleEdge() {}
        SimpleEdge(int trg) { this.trg = trg; }
    }

    static class WeightedEdge<T> {
        int trg;
        T weight;
        WeightedEdge() {}
        WeightedEdge(int trg, T weight) { this.trg = trg; this.weight = weight; }
    }

    static class GraphBase<EdgeType> {
        List<Node> nodes;

        static class Node {
            List<EdgeType> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        public GraphBase(int size) {
            nodes = new ArrayList<>(size);
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                nodes.add(new Node());
            }
        }

        public int size() {
            return nodes.size();
        }

        public Node getNode(int id) {
            return nodes.get(id);
        }
    }

    static class UGGraph extends GraphBase<SimpleEdge> {
        public UGGraph(int size) {
            super(size);
        }

        public void add1(int a, int b) {
            getNode(a).edges.add(new SimpleEdge(b));
        }

        public void add2(int a, int b) {
            add1(a, b);
            add1(b, a);
        }
    }

    static class WGraph<T> extends GraphBase<WeightedEdge<T>> {
        public WGraph(int size) {
            super(size);
        }

        public void add1(int a, int b, T weight) {
            getNode(a).edges.add(new WeightedEdge<>(b, weight));
        }

        public void add2(int a, int b, T weight) {
            add1(a, b, weight);
            add1(b, a, weight);
        }
    }

    static class MCMFEdge<T> {
        int trg;
        T cost;
        T adjcost;
        T flow;
        T cap;
        int dual;

        public MCMFEdge(int trg, T cost, T cap, int dual) {
            this.trg = trg;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.adjcost = cost;
            this.flow = null;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.dual = dual;
        }
    }

    static class MCMFGraph<T> extends GraphBase<MCMFEdge<T>> {
        public MCMFGraph(int size) {
            super(size);
        }

        class PQItem implements Comparable<PQItem> {
            int trg;
            T prio;

            public PQItem(int trg, T prio) {
                this.trg = trg;
                this.prio = prio;
            }

            @Override
            public int compareTo(PQItem o) {
                // Assuming T is comparable
                return ((Comparable<T>) this.prio).compareTo(o.prio);
            }
        }

        public void add(int a, int b, T cost, T cap, T rcap) {
            int sizeA = size(a);
            int sizeB = size(b);
            if (a == b) return;
            if (Comparable<T>.compare(cap, zero()) > 0 && Comparable<T>.compare(rcap, zero()) > 0) {
                add(a, b, cost, cap, zero());
                add(b, a, cost, cap, zero());
            } else if (Comparable<T>.compare(rcap, zero()) > 0) {
                add(b, a, cost, rcap, zero());
            } else {
                getNode(a).edges.add(new MCMFEdge<>(b, cost, cap, sizeB));
                getNode(b).edges.add(new MCMFEdge<>(a, negate(cost), zero(), sizeA));
            }
        }

        public Pair<T, T> augment(int source, int sink) {
            int N = size();
            T big = maxValue();

            T[] upby = (T[]) new Object[N];
            T[] prio = (T[]) new Object[N];
            int[] preve = new int[N];

            Arrays.fill(prio, big);
            Arrays.fill(upby, big);
            PriorityQueue<PQItem> q = new PriorityQueue<>();

            prio[source] = zero();
            upby[source] = big;
            q.add(new PQItem(source, zero()));

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                PQItem item = q.poll();
                int cur = item.trg;
                T p = item.prio;
                if (!p.equals(prio[cur])) continue;
                List<MCMFEdge<T>> edges = getNode(cur).edges;
                for (int i = 0; i < edges.size(); i++) {
                    MCMFEdge<T> e = edges.get(i);
                    T p2 = add(p, e.adjcost);
                    if (less(e.flow, e.cap) && less(p2, prio[e.trg])) {
                        prio[e.trg] = p2;
                        preve[e.trg] = e.dual;
                        upby[e.trg] = min(e.cap, upby[cur]);
                        q.add(new PQItem(e.trg, p2));
                    }
                }
            }

            T up = upby[sink];
            T upcost = zero();
            if (greater(up, zero())) {
                int cur = sink;
                while (cur != source) {
                    MCMFEdge<T> ed = getNode(cur).edges.get(preve[cur]);
                    MCMFEdge<T> e = getNode(ed.trg).edges.get(ed.dual);
                    e.flow = add(e.flow, up);
                    upcost = add(upcost, multiply(e.cost, up));
                    ed.flow = subtract(ed.flow, up);
                    cur = ed.trg;
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                    List<MCMFEdge<T>> edges = getNode(i).edges;
                    for (int j = 0; j < edges.size(); j++) {
                        MCMFEdge<T> e = edges.get(j);
                        e.adjcost = add(e.adjcost, subtract(prio[i], prio[e.trg]));
                    }
                }
            }
            return new Pair<>(up, upcost);
        }

        public Pair<T, T> make_flow(int source, int sink) {
            int N = size();
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (MCMFEdge<T> e : getNode(i).edges) {
                    e.flow = zero();
                    e.adjcost = e.cost;
                }
            }
            T flow = zero();
            T cost = zero();
            Pair<T, T> up;
            while (!(up = augment(source, sink)).first.equals(zero())) {
                flow = add(flow, up.first);
                cost = add(cost, up.second);
            }
            return new Pair<>(flow, cost);
        }

        private T zero() {
            return (T) (new Integer(0));
        }

        private T maxValue() {
            return (T) (new Integer(Integer.MAX_VALUE));
        }

        private T add(T a, T b) {
            if (a instanceof Integer && b instanceof Integer) {
                return (T) (Integer) (((Integer) a) + ((Integer) b));
            }
            // Add other types if needed
            return null;
        }

        private T subtract(T a, T b) {
            if (a instanceof Integer && b instanceof Integer) {
                return (T) (Integer) (((Integer) a) - ((Integer) b));
            }
            return null;
        }

        private T multiply(T a, T b) {
            if (a instanceof Integer && b instanceof Integer) {
                return (T) (Integer) (((Integer) a) * ((Integer) b));
            }
            return null;
        }

        private boolean less(T a, T b) {
            if (a instanceof Integer && b instanceof Integer) {
                return (Integer) a < (Integer) b;
            }
            return false;
        }

        private boolean greater(T a, T b) {
            if (a instanceof Integer && b instanceof Integer) {
                return (Integer) a > (Integer) b;
            }
            return false;
        }

        private T negate(T a) {
            if (a instanceof Integer) {
                return (T) (Integer) (-((Integer) a));
            }
            return null;
        }
    }

    static class Pair<U, V> {
        public U first;
        public V second;
        public Pair(U first, V second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int M = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int K = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int C = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int D = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int[] a = new int[K];
        int[] starts = new int[N];
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            a[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            starts[a[i]]++;
        }

        int maxT = K + N + 1;
        int V = (maxT + 1) * N + 2;
        int src = V - 2;
        int sink = V - 1;
        MCMFGraph<Integer> g = new MCMFGraph<>(V);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (starts[i] > 0) {
                g.add(src, i, 0, starts[i], 0);
            }
        }

        for (int t = 0; t <= maxT; t++) {
            g.add(t * N, sink, 0, K, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < maxT; t++) {
                g.add(t * N + i, (t + 1) * N + i, C, K, 0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            for (int t = 0; t < maxT; t++) {
                g.add(t * N + u, (t + 1) * N + v, C + (2 * 0 + 1) * D, 1, 0);
                g.add(t * N + v, (t + 1) * N + u, C + (2 * 0 + 1) * D, 1, 0);
            }
        }

        Pair<Integer, Integer> fc = g.make_flow(src, sink);
        if (!fc.first.equals(K)) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Flow does not match K");
        }
        System.out.println(fc.second);
    }
}
